descriptionByLocale.en:
Description
- Management of research and personnel selection processes, including publication of job ads, interview planning and follow-up with candidates
- HR and payroll administration activities for Switzerland
- Coordination with payroll providers of the Group's foreign offices
- Management and monitoring of company material assigned to employees
- Internal communications for employees on general business issues
- Support department managers in contract management and personnel documentation
descriptionByLocale.de:
Warenbezeichnung

- Personal- und Lohnverwaltungstätigkeiten für die Schweiz
- Koordination mit Zahlstellenanbietern der Außenstellen der Gruppe
